svg.title: Juan Pablo Morais Stein — terminal profile
svg.desc: Neofetch-inspired profile. ASCII portrait sampled from Juan's photograph, including his hairstyle, earbud and phone. Juan is 18 years old, from Gaspar, Santa Catarina, Brazil; a Computer Science Student at FURB focused on Web Development with Java. OS: Omarchy / Arch Linux. Editor: Visual Studio Code. Languages: Portuguese (Native). Instagram: @juan_stein. Email: juanpablomoraisstein@gmail.com.
